events.text: Restoring the original coastal-city-sketch scale as a 25x25 native chunk square (3km x 3km / 9km2), with coherent full-scale districts and non-duplicated transit. Native audit found the old cz<=8 ceiling plus a 449MiB monolithic JS wire and ~500MiB worst-case save scratch, so the implementation is also moving generation to a one-chunk-at-a-time native install transaction rather than masking the scale change behind memory-heavy constants.

Expanded the coastal baseline to 25x25 chunks (625 total), covering exactly 3,000m x 3,000m / 9.0km2. Default seed 18473 now produces 194 roads (115.54km), 5 light-rail alignments, 1 regional railway, 6 distinct crossings, and 2,885 floor-only building sites. Installation streams one reusable chunk buffer into a native transaction; exact save sizing avoids a roughly 483MiB worst-case scratch allocation. Verified planner/document tests, all 625 packed chunks and finite coordinates, Zig game-map/world-loader tests, ReleaseFast editor build, and the full Zig 0.16 editor gate.

resolution: The coastal generator now covers a 25-by-25 native chunk world, yielding a continuous 3 km by 3 km urban region (9.0 km2) with restored coast, mountain, road, light-rail, railway, and floor-site density. Chunk installation is streamed and persistence uses exact sizing so the expanded world does not require the former giant JavaScript payload or maximum-size save scratch buffer. Automated planner, document, native map, world-loader, complete 625-chunk data sweep, ReleaseFast editor build, and full Zig 0.16 editor gate all pass; only user visual and 60-second frame-time verification remain.
